meanings: prop, support (for weight), rest (e.g. arm rest), thanks to, to hold in one's hand, to support in one's palm, to give, to base, to commit, to set, torr (unit of pressure), to trust, to entrust, to be entrusted with, to act as trustee
variant of 拖, to drag, to tow, to trail, to hang down, to mop (the floor), to delay, to drag on
to dig, to excavate, to scoop out
